title: PDAC 1 minute 8 arm sensor record
description: Per arm per tick sensor record with 80 channels at mixed 100 kHz force plus 10 kHz command rates.

tick.description: 10 microsecond tick index for the 100 kHz force channel; 100 microsecond tick index for the 10 kHz command channel

q.description: 7 joint angle radians q1 to q7

qd.description: 7 joint angular velocity rad/s qd1 to qd7

tau.description: 7 joint torque N.m tau1 to tau7

ee_pos.description: end effector position x y z mm in patient frame

ee_quat.description: end effector orientation quaternion qx qy qz qw

ee_force.description: end effector force Fx Fy Fz N at 100 kHz

ee_torque.description: end effector torque Tx Ty Tz N.m at 100 kHz

tool_subtype.description: per arm installed tool model identifier

vessel_proximity.description: distance from tip to nearest active vessel surface mm (PDAC specific)

nir_icg.description: NIR indocyanine green 4 channel intensity at 800 nm (PDAC specific)

duct_manometry.description: pancreatic duct pressure mmHg (PDAC specific, Phase 5)

ring_tension.description: anastomosis ring tension N (PDAC specific, Phases 5 6 7)

bile_spectrophotometry.description: bile spectrophotometry at 410 470 532 600 nm (PDAC specific, Phase 6)

us_b_mode.description: ultrasound 8 element B mode amplitude dB (PDAC specific)

heartbeat_seq.description: per arm 10 kHz heartbeat broadcast sequence

heartbeat_watchdog.description: per arm heartbeat watchdog microseconds since last broadcast

tip_force_scalar.description: per arm scalar magnitude of force vector N at 100 kHz

cumulative_cross_arm_force.description: cross arm sum of tip force magnitudes N at 100 kHz

force_time_integral.description: per arm cumulative force time integral over phase duration N.s

engagement_depth.description: per arm tool insertion depth at tip mm

temperature.description: per arm internal temperature deg C

power.description: per arm motor power consumption W

tool_changer_state.description: per arm tool changer carousel state

task_id.description: per arm current task identifier in the 8 phase timeline

queue_depth.description: per arm pending command queue depth
